age.title: Are you 18 or older?
age.body: This app is for 18+ only, the legal drinking age in the Philippines.
age.refusedBody: This one's strictly for 18 and up. Take care.
age.responsible: Drink responsibly and look out for each other.

home.tagline: Drinking games for the barkada. One phone, passed around.
home.footer: Pace yourselves. Drink water, and nobody drives drunk.

players.title: Players
players.emptyBody: Add everyone's name. This is also the turn order.
players.orderHint: This is the turn order. Tap a name to rename.

error.duplicate: That name's taken. Add an initial, e.g. "Migs B."

lobby.noView: The rules are ready but the table view isn't yet. Coming soon!

packs.title: Prompt packs
packs.help: Choose which packs to deal from.
packs.none: No prompts match. Pick a pack or raise the spice level.

rulesUi.invalid: Some rules aren't valid. Fix them before starting.

intensity.nonAlcModeHelp: Juice, soda or water for everyone.
intensity.multiplierHelp: Scales every drink up or down.
intensity.maxSipsHelp: Most sips anyone drinks in one turn.
intensity.allowFinishHelp: Off by default. When off, it's capped at the max instead.
intensity.waterHelp: Reminds everyone to drink water every few minutes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.qualityHelp: If your phone lags, choose Low.
settings.responsibleBody: It's just a game. Anyone can stop or switch to non-alcoholic anytime, no pressure.
settings.creditsBody: 3D bar made in Blender with free CC0 (public domain) assets from Poly Haven:
settings.benchHelp: Check how well this phone handles the 3D.

theme.title: Table look
theme.previewCaption: Your table at a glance. Changes show up in the game right away.

envHelp.dive-bar: Full 3D bar with neon. Downloads on first play.
envHelp.procedural-bar: Lighter, no download. Best for older phones.

theme.customAria: Pick your own color for the {{what}}

over.title: That's it!
over.body: Thanks for playing. Get home safe, and nobody drives drunk.

hl.prompt: Is the next card higher or lower?

pass.aria: Pass it to {{name}}. Tap to continue.
pass.private: Eyes only for you. No peeking, everyone else.

parusa.title: Penalty
parusa.help: Someone broke a house rule? Pick who, then how many sips.

tally.title: Drink count
tally.note: It's not a contest. If someone's had a lot, water first.

lost.title: Graphics paused
lost.body: Tap to bring them back. Your game is safe.

kcui.firstBody: Take turns drawing from the circle. What each card means shows up here.
kcui.noRules: No house rules yet. Draw a Jack to make one.

nhieui.endBody: That's every prompt. Thanks for the stories!

packs.title: Prompt packs
packs.intro: Write your own prompts for the barkada, or import one someone sent to the group chat.
packs.emptyTitle: No packs of your own yet.
packs.emptyBody: Start from scratch, or copy a built-in pack to edit it.
packs.noneForGame: No packs here yet. Make one!
packs.name: Pack name
packs.localeHelp: You can still pick it when the app is in another language.
packs.firstPromptsHelp: One prompt per line. You can add more later.

linesPlaceholder.never-have-i-ever:
Never have I ever ghosted someone.
Never have I ever fallen asleep in a cinema.
linesPlaceholder.truth-or-dare:
Who's your crush in the group?
Sing the chorus of your favorite OPM song.
linesPlaceholder.most-likely-to:
Most likely to be late to their own wedding
Most likely to go viral on TikTok

composerPlaceholder.truth-or-dare: e.g. What's the most cringe text you sent {random}?

packs.readOnly: This one ships with the app, so it's read-only. Make a copy to make it yours.
packs.bulkHelp: One prompt per line. Bullets and numbers at the start are removed.
packs.bulkPartial: Added {{added}}. {{count}} were over 280 characters — they're still here to shorten.
packs.placeholderHelp: {player} = the reader · {random} = anyone · {left}/{right} = the person on the left/right
packs.unknownPlaceholder: Unknown: {{list}}. Only {player}, {random}, {left} and {right} get filled in.
packs.missing: Can't find this pack. It may have been deleted.

error.emptyName: Give the pack a name first.
error.lineTooLong: {{count}} line(s) are over {{max}} characters. Shorten them first.
error.lastItem: A pack needs at least one prompt.
error.tooManyPacks: That's a lot of packs. Delete some first.
error.loading: Hang on, packs are still loading.

share.badVersion: This link is from a different app version. Refresh the app to update, then try again.
share.corrupt: This link is broken — it may have been cut off when copied. Ask for it again.
share.invalid: Something in this link or file isn't valid.
share.tooLarge: This is too big to import (max 1 MB).

method.qr: Easiest: let them scan the QR, or send the link to the group chat.
method.link: Too long for a QR code, so send the link to the group chat instead.
method.file: Too big for a link ({{count}} characters, max {{max}}). Download the file and send it to the group chat — they can import it under Prompt packs.

share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Long-press the link to copy it.
share.downloaded: Downloaded! Send the file to the group chat.
share.shareFailed: Couldn't share. Try the link or the file.

import.title: Someone shared this!
import.intro: Have a look before saving. Nothing you already have gets replaced or deleted.
import.emptyBody: Open the full link you were sent, or import the file from Prompt packs.
import.errorHint: Nothing was saved. Your packs are safe.
import.unknownGame: These rules are for a game this app doesn't have.
import.themeUnsupported: Themes can't be imported yet. Coming soon!
import.themeIntro: Have a look first. You can switch back to your old look after.
import.themeSame: This is exactly your current table look.
import.themeNote: This replaces your table look. You can undo it right after.
import.themeAppliedBody: Your table now has this look.
import.themeUndoneBody: Your table is back to how it was.
import.noGameYet: That game isn't playable yet, but you can save the pack now.
import.packNote: Saved as a new pack you can still edit.
import.rulesNote: Saved as a preset. Your current rules stay as they are.
import.savedPack: It's in your packs now. Pick it in the lobby before you play.
import.savedRules: Saved as "{{name}}" for {{game}}. Find it under Saved rules in the lobby.

mltui.voteAsk: You're up, {{name}}. Who do you think?
mltui.secretHint: Only you can see this. Just the totals come out at the end.

rtbui.pyramidHint: Flip the first card on the bottom row.

qtui.swipeHint: Swipe up to bounce the coin
qtui.mustBounceHint: It has to bounce off the table before it goes in.
qtui.noRules: No house rules yet. Get a streak to make one.

fcui.tapHint: Or tap Flip it! when the needle is in the gold band.

audio.soundHelp: Turn off to silence everything: effects, music and bar noise.
audio.sfxHelp: Cards, dice, clinking glasses, button taps.
audio.musicHelp: Low in the background while you play.
audio.ambienceHelp: Low chatter and clinks around you, like a real bar.
audio.mixHelp: Keep your own Spotify playing while you play (iPhone).
audio.hapticsHelp: A little buzz on taps, wins and drinks.
audio.testHelp: A card, dice, then a toast: check the levels.
audio.speaker: Sound

opm-acoustic.title: OPM Acoustic
opm-acoustic.vibe: Chill guitar for a night of drinks

lofi-lounge.title: Lofi Lounge
lofi-lounge.vibe: Jazzy and relaxed, stays in the background
